    &lt;/div&gt;`
  ).join(&#x27;&#x27;);

    };
  });
}

window.PPA_PVP_SET_RATING=function(data){
  data=data||{};
  if(Number.isFinite(Number(data.rating)))PVP_RATING.rating=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(data.rating)));
  if(Number.isFinite(Number(data.wins)))PVP_RATING.wins=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(data.wins)));
  if(Number.isFinite(Number(data.losses)))PVP_RATING.losses=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(data.losses)));
  if(Number.isFinite(Number(data.best)))PVP_RATING.best=Math.max(PVP_RATING.rating,Math.floor(Number(data.best)));
  else PVP_RATING.best=Math.max(PVP_RATING.best,PVP_RATING.rating);
  if(Number.isFinite(Number(data.streak)))PVP_RATING.streak=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(data.streak)));
  pvpSaveRating();sendArenaMenuState();return Object.assign({},PVP_RATING);
};

function pvpShopLoad(){
  let x=null;try{x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pxArenaShopDailyV52')||'null')}catch(_){}
  const today=pvpLocalDayKey();
  if(!x||x.date!==today)x={date:today,bought:{}};
  if(!x.bought||typeof x.bought!=='object')x.bought={};
  return x;
}
let PVP_SHOP_DAILY=pvpShopLoad();
function pvpShopEnsure(){
  if(!PVP_SHOP_DAILY||PVP_SHOP_DAILY.date!==pvpLocalDayKey())PVP_SHOP_DAILY=pvpShopLoad();
  return PVP_SHOP_DAILY;
}
function pvpShopSave(){try{localStorage.setItem('pxArenaShopDailyV52',JSON.stringify(PVP_SHOP_DAILY))}catch(_){}}
function pvpShopState(){
  pvpShopEnsure();
  return PVP_SHOP_ITEMS.map(function(it){
    const bought=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(PVP_SHOP_DAILY.bought[it.id])||0));
    return {id:it.id,name:it.name,icon:it.icon,price:it.price,limit:it.limit,bought:bought,left:Math.max(0,it.limit-bought),
      minRating:it.minRating,unlocked:PVP_RATING.rating>=it.minRating,rankReq:pvpRankInfo(it.minRating).name};
  });
}

const POTION_COOLDOWN_MS=10000;
function potionCooldownKey(group){return group==='mp'?'mpUntil':'hpUntil'}
function potionCooldownLeft(group){
  if(!INV.potionCooldowns)INV.potionCooldowns={hpUntil:0,mpUntil:0};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.potionCooldowns[potionCooldownKey(group)]||0)-Date.now());
}
function potionCooldownBlocked(group){
  var left=potionCooldownLeft(group);
  if(left<=0)return false;
  showPickup((group==='mp'?'MP':'HP')+' зелье · откат '+Math.ceil(left/1000)+' сек','#ffd16b');
  return true;
}
function startPotionCooldown(group){
  if(!INV.potionCooldowns)INV.potionCooldowns={hpUntil:0,mpUntil:0};
  INV.potionCooldowns[potionCooldownKey(group)]=Date.now()+POTION_COOLDOWN_MS;
}
function healPotion(key,amount,label){
  if((INV.potions[key]||0)<=0){showPickup('Нет: '+label,'#ff7777');return false}
  if(P.hp>=P.mhp){showPickup('HP уже полное','#ffd16b');return false}
  if(potionCooldownBlocked('hp'))return false;
  INV.potions[key]--;
  startPotionCooldown('hp');

// === FENCE DRAWING (safe zone boundary) ===
function drawFence(){
  const b=SCENES.safe.bounds;
  cx.strokeStyle='#665533';
  cx.lineWidth=3;
  cx.fillStyle='#554422';
  for(let x=b.minX;x<=b.maxX;x+=22){
    const tx=x-cam.x,ty=b.minY-cam.y;
    if(tx>-20&&tx<cv.width+20){
      cx.fillRect(tx-1,ty-7,4,10);
      cx.fillRect(tx+9,ty-7,4,10);
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(tx-1,ty-3);cx.lineTo(tx+13,ty-3);cx.stroke();
    }
    const bx=x-cam.x,by=b.maxY-cam.y;
    if(bx>-20&&bx<cv.width+20){
      cx.fillRect(bx-1,by-3,4,10);
      cx.fillRect(bx+9,by-3,4,10);
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(bx-1,by+1);cx.lineTo(bx+13,by+1);cx.stroke();
    }
  }
  for(let y=b.minY;y<=b.maxY;y+=22){
    const lx=b.minX-cam.x,ly=y-cam.y;
    if(ly>-20&&ly<cv.height+20){
      cx.fillRect(lx-7,ly-1,10,4);
      cx.fillRect(lx-7,ly+9,10,4);
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(lx-3,ly-1);cx.lineTo(lx-3,ly+13);cx.stroke();
    }
    const rx=b.maxX-cam.x,ry=y-cam.y;
    if(ry>-20&&ry<cv.height+20){
      cx.fillRect(rx-3,ry-1,10,4);
      cx.fillRect(rx-3,ry+9,10,4);
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(rx+1,ry-1);cx.lineTo(rx+1,ry+13);cx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

// === Click on character opens inventory ===
cv.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  if(P.dead||transitioning)return;
  const rect=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  const z=cameraZoom();
  const wx=(e.clientX-rect.left)/z+cam.x,wy=(e.clientY-rect.top)/z+cam.y;
  if(Math.hypot(wx-P.x,wy-P.y)<P.sz*0.5){openInventory()}
});
cv.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
  if(P.dead||transitioning)return;
  const rect=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  const t=e.touches[0];
  const z=cameraZoom();
  const wx=(t.clientX-rect.left)/z+cam.x,wy=(t.clientY-rect.top)/z+cam.y;
  if(Math.hypot(wx-P.x,wy-P.y)<P.sz*0.5){e.preventDefault();openInventory()}
},{passive:false});

function kqEnsureUi(){
  const box=document.getElementById('dungeonGateBox');if(!box)return null;
  let p=document.getElementById('keeperQuestPanel');if(p)return p;
  p=document.createElement('div');p.id='keeperQuestPanel';
  p.innerHTML='<div id="keeperQuestHead"><b>ПОРУЧЕНИЯ ХРАНИТЕЛЯ</b><span>Награда после сдачи → сразу в сумку</span></div><div id="keeperQuestTabs"><button class="keeperQuestTab" data-kqtab="1-20">1–20</button><button class="keeperQuestTab" data-kqtab="21-30">21–30</button><button class="keeperQuestTab" data-kqtab="31-40">31–40</button><button class="keeperQuestTab" data-kqtab="daily">ЕЖЕДНЕВНЫЕ</button></div><div id="keeperQuestBody"></div>';
  const status=document.getElementById('dungeonKeeperStatus');box.insertBefore(p,status||document.getElementById('dungeonGateActions'));
  p.querySelectorAll('[data-kqtab]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){KQ_ACTIVE_TAB=b.dataset.kqtab;kqRender()})});
  return p;
}
function kqRender(){
  const p=kqEnsureUi();if(!p)return;kqState();
  if(!KQ_ACTIVE_TAB){const lv=Number(P.lvl)||1;KQ_ACTIVE_TAB=lv>=31?'31-40':lv>=21?'21-30':'1-20'}
  p.querySelectorAll('[data-kqtab]').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.kqtab===KQ_ACTIVE_TAB);const g=KQ_GROUPS[b.dataset.kqtab];b.classList.toggle('locked',!!g&&Number(P.lvl)<g.min)});
  const body=document.getElementById('keeperQuestBody');if(!body)return;
  if(KQ_ACTIVE_TAB==='daily'){body.innerHTML=kqDailyBody();return}
  const g=KQ_GROUPS[KQ_ACTIVE_TAB]||KQ_GROUPS['1-20'];
  body.innerHTML=g.ids.map(kqQuestCard).join('')+kqChainCard(KQ_ACTIVE_TAB)+'<div class="keeperQuestNote">Разовые поручения и их награды можно получить только один раз на персонажа. Прогресс сохраняется.</div>';
}
window.PPA_KEEPER_QUEST_RENDER=kqRender;

function merchantBuy(id,qty){
  var p=MERCHANT_DB[id];if(!p)return;
  qty=Math.max(1,Math.min(999,Math.floor(Number(qty)||1)));
  var total=p.price*qty,cur=p.currency==='ppa'?'ppa':'gold',curName=cur==='ppa'?'PPA':'Gold';
  if((INV[cur]||0)<total){merchantNotice('Не хватает '+curName+' · нужно '+total.toLocaleString('ru-RU'));showPickup('Не хватает '+curName,'#ff7777');return}
  INV[cur]-=total;
  if(id==='hp_small')INV.potions.hp=(INV.potions.hp||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='hp_medium')INV.potions.hpMedium=(INV.potions.hpMedium||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='hp_large')INV.potions.hpLarge=(INV.potions.hpLarge||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_small')INV.potions.mp=(INV.potions.mp||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_medium')INV.potions.mpMedium=(INV.potions.mpMedium||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_large')INV.potions.mpLarge=(INV.potions.mpLarge||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='magic_small')INV.consumables.magicSmall=(INV.consumables.magicSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='atk_speed_small')INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall=(INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='run_speed_small')INV.consumables.speedSmall=(INV.consumables.speedSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='phys_small')INV.consumables.physSmall=(INV.consumables.physSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='xp_scroll')INV.consumables.xpScroll=(INV.consumables.xpScroll||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='portal_scroll')INV.consumables.portalStone=(INV.consumables.portalStone||0)+qty;
  saveGame();sendInvState();sendMerchantState();updateUI();
  merchantNotice('Куплено: '+p.name+' ×'+qty);showPickup('Куплено · '+p.name+' ×'+qty+' · -'+total.toLocaleString('ru-RU')+' '+curName,'#8dff9a');
}

function closeMerchant(){var mf=document.getElementById('merchantFrame');if(mf)mf.style.display='none'}
function merchantBuy(id,qty){
  var p=MERCHANT_DB[id];if(!p)return;
  qty=Math.max(1,Math.min(999,Math.floor(Number(qty)||1)));
  var total=p.price*qty,cur=p.currency==='ppa'?'ppa':'gold',curName=cur==='ppa'?'PPA':'Gold';
  if((INV[cur]||0)<total){merchantNotice('Не хватает '+curName+' · нужно '+total.toLocaleString('ru-RU'));showPickup('Не хватает '+curName,'#ff7777');return}
  INV[cur]-=total;
  if(id==='hp_small')INV.potions.hp=(INV.potions.hp||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='hp_medium')INV.potions.hpMedium=(INV.potions.hpMedium||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='hp_large')INV.potions.hpLarge=(INV.potions.hpLarge||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_small')INV.potions.mp=(INV.potions.mp||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_medium')INV.potions.mpMedium=(INV.potions.mpMedium||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='mp_large')INV.potions.mpLarge=(INV.potions.mpLarge||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='magic_small')INV.consumables.magicSmall=(INV.consumables.magicSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='atk_speed_small')INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall=(INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='run_speed_small')INV.consumables.speedSmall=(INV.consumables.speedSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='phys_small')INV.consumables.physSmall=(INV.consumables.physSmall||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='xp_scroll')INV.consumables.xpScroll=(INV.consumables.xpScroll||0)+qty;
  else if(id==='portal_scroll')INV.consumables.portalStone=(INV.consumables.portalStone||0)+qty;
  saveGame();sendInvState();sendMerchantState();updateUI();
  merchantNotice('Куплено: '+p.name+' ×'+qty);showPickup('Куплено · '+p.name+' ×'+qty+' · -'+total.toLocaleString('ru-RU')+' '+curName,'#8dff9a');
}

function auctionSuggestedPrice(it){
  if(!it)return 1;
  if(it.kind==='gear')return Math.max(1,Math.round((it.sell||10)*2));
  if(it.kind==='consumable')return ({hp_small:100,hp_medium:250,hp_large:500,mp_small:100,mp_medium:250,mp_large:500,magic_small:750,atk_speed_small:750,run_speed_small:750,phys_small:750,xp_scroll:1000})[it.refId]||100;
  if(it.kind==='stone')return ({normal:350,premium:900,rune:2500})[it.refId]||350;
  if(it.kind==='feather')return 1800;
  if(it.kind==='grimoire')return 2500;
  return 120;
}

  if(id==='mp_small')return INV.potions.mp||0;if(id==='mp_medium')return INV.potions.mpMedium||0;if(id==='mp_large')return INV.potions.mpLarge||0;
  if(id==='magic_small')return INV.consumables.magicSmall||0;if(id==='atk_speed_small')return INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall||0;if(id==='run_speed_small')return INV.consumables.speedSmall||0;if(id==='phys_small')return INV.consumables.physSmall||0;if(id==='xp_scroll')return INV.consumables.xpScroll||0;if(id==='premium_hp_regen')return INV.consumables.premiumHpRegen||0;if(id==='premium_mp_regen')return INV.consumables.premiumMpRegen||0;if(id==='luck_coin')return INV.consumables.luckCoin||0;
  return 0;
}

function closeItemPopup(){
  document.getElementById(&#x27;itemPop&#x27;).classList.remove(&#x27;show&#x27;);
  _popMode=null;_popSlot=null;_popSkillId=null;_popCanAct=false;_popConsumableId=null;
}
function bagClick(i){
  buildBagView();
  var v=_bagView[i];if(!v||!v.it)return;
  _sel=i;renderBag();
  if(v.kind===&#x27;gear&#x27;){
    _sel=v.bagIndex;
    openItemPopup(v.it,&#x27;bag&#x27;,null);
  }else if(v.kind===&#x27;grimoire&#x27;){
    openGrimoirePopup(v.it);
  }else{
    openResourcePopup(v.it);
  }
}
function slotClick(s){
  var it=_inv.equipped[s];if(it)openItemPopup(it,&#x27;equipped&#x27;,s);
}
function itemPrimaryAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;resource&#x27;){
    if(_popConsumableId){
      if(isQuickPotionId(_popConsumableId))parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipQuickPotion&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
      else parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;useConsumable&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    }
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;grimoire&#x27;){
    if(_popCanAct&amp;&amp;_popSkillId)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;grimoireAction&#x27;,skillId:_popSkillId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return;
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  else if(_popMode===&#x27;equipped&#x27;&amp;&amp;_popSlot)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;unequipItem&#x27;,slot:_popSlot},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function itemSellAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;sellItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function doEquip(){itemPrimaryAction()}
function doSell(){itemSellAction()}

// === V66 PREMIUM REGEN POTIONS ===
let _premiumRegenStamp=Date.now(),_premiumRegenCarry=0;
function updatePremiumRegen(){
  var now=Date.now(),dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(2500,now-_premiumRegenStamp));
  _premiumRegenStamp=now;
  if(P.dead){_premiumRegenCarry=0;return}
  var inPvp=P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam';
  var hpPotion=!inPvp&&now<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).premiumHpUntil||0);
  var mpPotion=!inPvp&&now<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).premiumMpUntil||0);
  var hpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.hpRegen)||0);
  var mpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.mpRegen)||0);
  if(!hpPotion&&!mpPotion&&!hpPet&&!mpPet){_premiumRegenCarry=0;return}
  _premiumRegenCarry+=dt;
  if(_premiumRegenCarry<1000)return;
  var ticks=Math.min(2,Math.floor(_premiumRegenCarry/1000));
  _premiumRegenCarry-=ticks*1000;
  var hpPer=(hpPotion?5:0)+hpPet,mpPer=(mpPotion?5:0)+mpPet;
  if(hpPer>0&&P.hp<P.mhp)P.hp=Math.min(P.mhp,P.hp+hpPer*ticks);
  if(mpPer>0&&P.mp<P.mmp)P.mp=Math.min(P.mmp,P.mp+mpPer*ticks);
}

  if(n.indexOf('кост')>=0)return 'bone';

// === V66 PREMIUM REGEN POTIONS ===
let _premiumRegenStamp=Date.now(),_premiumRegenCarry=0;
function updatePremiumRegen(){
  var now=Date.now(),dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(2500,now-_premiumRegenStamp));
  _premiumRegenStamp=now;
  if(P.dead){_premiumRegenCarry=0;return}
  var inPvp=P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam';
  var hpPotion=!inPvp&&now<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).premiumHpUntil||0);
  var mpPotion=!inPvp&&now<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).premiumMpUntil||0);
  var hpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.hpRegen)||0);
  var mpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.mpRegen)||0);
  if(!hpPotion&&!mpPotion&&!hpPet&&!mpPet){_premiumRegenCarry=0;return}
  _premiumRegenCarry+=dt;
  if(_premiumRegenCarry<1000)return;
  var ticks=Math.min(2,Math.floor(_premiumRegenCarry/1000));
  _premiumRegenCarry-=ticks*1000;
  var hpPer=(hpPotion?5:0)+hpPet,mpPer=(mpPotion?5:0)+mpPet;
  if(hpPer>0&&P.hp<P.mhp)P.hp=Math.min(P.mhp,P.hp+hpPer*ticks);
  if(mpPer>0&&P.mp<P.mmp)P.mp=Math.min(P.mmp,P.mp+mpPer*ticks);
}

function ppaSaveLooksRich(o){
  if(!o||typeof o!=='object')return false;
  if(Array.isArray(o.bag)&&o.bag.length)return true;
  if(o.equipped&&Object.keys(o.equipped).some(function(k){return !!o.equipped[k]}))return true;
  if(o.storage&&Object.keys(o.storage).some(function(k){return Array.isArray(o.storage[k])&&o.storage[k].length}))return true;
  if(o.grimoires&&Object.keys(o.grimoires).some(function(k){return Number(o.grimoires[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.skillRanks&&Object.keys(o.skillRanks).some(function(k){return Number(o.skillRanks[k])>0}))return true;
  if(Array.isArray(o.books)&&o.books.some(function(b){return b&&b.applied}))return true;
  return false;
}

anceForLevel(lv){

function pushGrimoireDrop(e){
  if(!ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)return;
  var g=ALL_GRIMOIRES[Math.floor(Math.random()*ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)];
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*40,
    kind:'grimoire',skillId:g.id,name:'Гримуар · '+g.n,skillName:g.n,
    classKey:g.classKey,className:g.className,skillType:g.type,rarity:'rare',icon:'📖',bob:Math.random()*6
  });
}
function tryGrimoireUpgrade(skillId){
  var sk=findGrimoireSkill(skillId);if(!sk)return;
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls);
  if(sk.classKey!==ck){showPickup('Гримуар другого класса: '+sk.className,'#ff8888');return;}
  var rank=skillRank(skillId),rule=skillRule(rank);
  if(!rule){showPickup(sk.n+' уже III ранга','#ffd168');return;}
  var have=(INV.grimoires&&INV.grimoires[skillId])||0;
  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}
  INV.grimoires[skillId]=have-rule.cost;
  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
// Determine which sprite row to use based on facing direction
// 0=back/up, 1=front/down, 2=side
function getDirRow(){
  // During standing attack OR run-and-attack, face the target/shot while
  // movement itself remains controlled by the joystick.
  if((P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0) && P.meleeAng !== undefined){
    const ax = Math.cos(P.meleeAng);
    const ay = Math.sin(P.meleeAng);
    if(Math.abs(ay) > Math.abs(ax) * 0.8){
      return ay > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  // During movement, use velocity with smooth direction switching
  const sp = Math.sqrt(P.vx*P.vx + P.vy*P.vy);
  if(sp > 0.5){
    // Use a threshold that favors vertical for more natural 4-dir movement
    if(Math.abs(P.vy) > Math.abs(P.vx) * 0.8){
      P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if(Math.abs(P.vx) > Math.abs(P.vy) * 0.8) {
      P.lastDir = 2;
    } else {
      // Diagonal: pick based on dominant axis
      if(Math.abs(P.vy) >= Math.abs(P.vx)) {
        P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        P.lastDir = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return P.lastDir;
}

  var have=(INV.grimoires&&INV.grimoires[skillId])||0;
  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}
  INV.grimoires[skillId]=have-rule.cost;
  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
// Determine which sprite row to use based on facing direction
// 0=back/up, 1=front/down, 2=side
function getDirRow(){
  // During standing attack OR run-and-attack, face the target/shot while
  // movement itself remains controlled by the joystick.
  if((P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0) && P.meleeAng !== undefined){
    const ax = Math.cos(P.meleeAng);
    const ay = Math.sin(P.meleeAng);
    if(Math.abs(ay) > Math.abs(ax) * 0.8){
      return ay > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  // During movement, use velocity with smooth direction switching
  const sp = Math.sqrt(P.vx*P.vx + P.vy*P.vy);
  if(sp > 0.5){
    // Use a threshold that favors vertical for more natural 4-dir movement
    if(Math.abs(P.vy) > Math.abs(P.vx) * 0.8){
      P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if(Math.abs(P.vx) > Math.abs(P.vy) * 0.8) {
      P.lastDir = 2;
    } else {
      // Diagonal: pick based on dominant axis
      if(Math.abs(P.vy) >= Math.abs(P.vx)) {
        P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        P.lastDir = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return P.lastDir;
}

    it={uid:'bm_wings_'+Date.now(),name:(RPREF[o.rarity]||'')+'Крылья',slot:'wings',rarity:o.rarity||'rare',enh:0,classKey:'all',className:'Все классы',icon:'🪽',img:(ws&&ws.S)||'',dirSprites:ws||null,stats:accessoryStatValues('wings',o.rarity||'rare'),sell:0,blackMarket:true}
  }else if(o.kind==='accessory'){
    var ak=o.slot||o.accessoryKind||'artifact',ar=o.rarity||'rare',ai='';
    if(ak==='cloak')ai=accessoryIconForRarity('cloak',ar)||'';
    else if(ak==='artifact')ai=accessoryIconForRarity('artifact',ar)||'';
    else if(ak==='necklace'){var nv=JEWELRY_VARIANTS.necklace||[];ai=nv.length?(nv[0].img||''):''}
    it={uid:'bm_'+ak+'_'+Date.now(),name:(RPREF[ar]||'')+(ak==='cloak'?'Плащ':ak==='necklace'?'Ожерелье':'Артефакт'),slot:ak,rarity:ar,enh:0,classKey:'all',className:'Все классы',icon:ak==='cloak'?'🧥':ak==='necklace'?'📿':'🔮',img:ai,stats:ak==='necklace'?Object.assign({},NECKLACE_STAT_VALUES[ar]||{}):accessoryStatValues(ak,ar),sell:0,blackMarket:true}
  }
  if(!it)return false;

  // V70: prepare Black Market physical item exactly like normal inventory gear.
  it.blackMarket=true;
  it.source='blackMarket';
  try{ppaHydrateItemArt(it)}catch(_){}
  try{
    if(['artifact','cloak','wings','necklace'].includes(it.slot))normalizeAccessoryItem(it);
    else syncItemBM(it);
  }catch(_){}
  INV.bag.push(it);

  // Verify the granted object really landed in the bag.
  return INV.bag.indexOf(it)>=0
}

      var va=GRIMOIRE_ART[x.id]||{};
      return {id:x.id,n:x.n,ic:x.ic,d:x.d,type:x.type,rank:rank,count:count,
        need:rule?rule.cost:0,chance:rule?Math.round(rule.chance*100):0,

    }

function ppaSaveLooksRich(o){
  if(!o||typeof o!=='object')return false;
  if(Array.isArray(o.bag)&&o.bag.length)return true;
  if(o.equipped&&Object.keys(o.equipped).some(function(k){return !!o.equipped[k]}))return true;
  if(o.storage&&Object.keys(o.storage).some(function(k){return Array.isArray(o.storage[k])&&o.storage[k].length}))return true;
  if(o.grimoires&&Object.keys(o.grimoires).some(function(k){return Number(o.grimoires[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.skillRanks&&Object.keys(o.skillRanks).some(function(k){return Number(o.skillRanks[k])>0}))return true;
  if(Array.isArray(o.books)&&o.books.some(function(b){return b&&b.applied}))return true;
  return false;
}

// V257 account isolation: a valid character save may legitimately have an empty
// bag (for example a brand-new player or someone who sold/moved all gear).
// playerName/progression/currency make it an owned character state too.
function ppaSaveHasCharacterState(o){
  if(!o||typeof o!=='object')return false;
  if(ppaSaveLooksRich(o))return true;
  if(/^[A-Za-zА-Яа-яЁё0-9_]{3,18}$/u.test(String(o.playerName||'').trim()))return true;
  if(Number(o.lvl)>1||Number(o.xp)>0||Number(o.kil)>0||Number(o.rebirths)>0)return true;
  if(Number(o.gold)>0||Number(o.gram)>0||Number(o.ppa)>0||Number(o.arenaTokens)>0||Number(o.renameCards)>0)return true;
  if(o.materials&&Object.keys(o.materials).some(function(k){return Number(o.materials[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.stones&&Object.keys(o.stones).some(function(k){return Number(o.stones[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.runes&&Object.keys(o.runes).some(function(k){return Number(o.runes[k])>0}))return true;
  return false;
}

function ppaLocalSavedNickname(){
  try{
    var raw=localStorage.getItem('pxSave')||localStorage.getItem('pxSaveLastGood')||'';
    var s=raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;
    return String((s&&s.playerName)||localStorage.getItem('ppaPlayerNameV205')||'').trim();
  }catch(_){return String(localStorage.getItem('ppaPlayerNameV205')||'').trim()}
}

      localStorage.getItem('pxSaveCleanV251LastGoodCleanV251')
    );
  }catch(_){return false}
}

  if(Array.isArray(o.bag)&&o.bag.length)return true;
  if(o.equipped&&Object.keys(o.equipped).some(function(k){return !!o.equipped[k]}))return true;
  if(o.storage&&Object.keys(o.storage).some(function(k){return Array.isArray(o.storage[k])&&o.storage[k].length}))return true;
  if(o.grimoires&&Object.keys(o.grimoires).some(function(k){return Number(o.grimoires[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.skillRanks&&Object.keys(o.skillRanks).some(function(k){return Number(o.skillRanks[k])>0}))return true;
  if(Array.isArray(o.books)&&o.books.some(function(b){return b&&b.applied}))return true;
  return false;
}

// V257 account isolation: a valid character save may legitimately have an empty
// bag (for example a brand-new player or someone who sold/moved all gear).
// playerName/progression/currency make it an owned character state too.
function ppaSaveHasCharacterState(o){
  if(!o||typeof o!=='object')return false;
  if(ppaSaveLooksRich(o))return true;
  if(/^[A-Za-zА-Яа-яЁё0-9_]{3,18}$/u.test(String(o.playerName||'').trim()))return true;
  if(Number(o.lvl)>1||Number(o.xp)>0||Number(o.kil)>0||Number(o.rebirths)>0)return true;
  if(Number(o.gold)>0||Number(o.gram)>0||Number(o.ppa)>0||Number(o.arenaTokens)>0||Number(o.renameCards)>0)return true;
  if(o.materials&&Object.keys(o.materials).some(function(k){return Number(o.materials[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.stones&&Object.keys(o.stones).some(function(k){return Number(o.stones[k])>0}))return true;
  if(o.runes&&Object.keys(o.runes).some(function(k){return Number(o.runes[k])>0}))return true;
  return false;
}
function ppaNickKey(v){return String(v||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ru-RU')}
function ppaLocalSavedNickname(){
  try{
    var raw=localStorage.getItem('pxSave')||localStorage.getItem('pxSaveLastGood')||'';
    var s=raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;
    return String((s&&s.playerName)||localStorage.getItem('ppaPlayerNameV205')||'').trim();
  }catch(_){return String(localStorage.getItem('ppaPlayerNameV205')||'').trim()}
}
function ppaHasAnyLocalCharacterCache(){
  try{
    return !!(
      localStorage.getItem('pxSave')||localStorage.getItem('pxSaveLastGood')||
      localStorage.getItem('pxSaveCleanV251')||localStorage.getItem('pxSaveLastGoodCleanV251')||
      localStorage.getItem('pxSaveCleanV251LastGoodCleanV251')
    );
  }catch(_){return false}
}

- NO direct HP / MP / ATK / DEF / crit / speed bonuses.
- Same tariff extends its current duration.
- Switching tariff starts the new tariff immediately and replaces remaining old time.
- Spending Gram does NOT count as verified lifetime paid Gram and does not create auction slots.
- Paid class change remains 10 Gram in the same Premium section.

DROP BONUS:
- Applied to random normal/boss loot rolls already governed by drop multipliers:
  gear/materials/stones/runes/grimoires/feathers.
- Applied to ordinary-mob PPA chance.
- Does not multiply guaranteed rewards/chests.
GOLD BONUS:

function closeItemPopup(){
  document.getElementById(&#x27;itemPop&#x27;).classList.remove(&#x27;show&#x27;);
  _popMode=null;_popSlot=null;_popSkillId=null;_popCanAct=false;_popConsumableId=null;
}
function bagClick(i){
  buildBagView();
  var v=_bagView[i];if(!v||!v.it)return;
  _sel=i;renderBag();
  if(v.kind===&#x27;gear&#x27;){
    _sel=v.bagIndex;
    openItemPopup(v.it,&#x27;bag&#x27;,null);
  }else if(v.kind===&#x27;grimoire&#x27;){
    openGrimoirePopup(v.it);
  }else{
    openResourcePopup(v.it);
  }
}
function slotClick(s){
  var it=_inv.equipped[s];if(it)openItemPopup(it,&#x27;equipped&#x27;,s);
}
function itemPrimaryAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;resource&#x27;){
    if(_popConsumableId){
      if(isQuickPotionId(_popConsumableId))parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipQuickPotion&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
      else parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;useConsumable&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    }
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;grimoire&#x27;){
    if(_popCanAct&amp;&amp;_popSkillId)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;grimoireAction&#x27;,skillId:_popSkillId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return;
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  else if(_popMode===&#x27;equipped&#x27;&amp;&amp;_popSlot)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;unequipItem&#x27;,slot:_popSlot},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function itemSellAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;sellItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function doEquip(){itemPrimaryAction()}
function doSell(){itemSellAction()}

function itemPrimaryAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;resource&#x27;){
    if(_popConsumableId){
      if(isQuickPotionId(_popConsumableId))parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipQuickPotion&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
      else parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;useConsumable&#x27;,id:_popConsumableId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    }
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;grimoire&#x27;){
    if(_popCanAct&amp;&amp;_popSkillId)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;grimoireAction&#x27;,skillId:_popSkillId},&#x27;*&#x27;);
    closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;return;
  }
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;equipItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  else if(_popMode===&#x27;equipped&#x27;&amp;&amp;_popSlot)parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;unequipItem&#x27;,slot:_popSlot},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function itemSellAction(){
  if(_popMode===&#x27;bag&#x27;&amp;&amp;_inv.bag[_sel])parent.postMessage({type:&#x27;sellItem&#x27;,idx:_sel},&#x27;*&#x27;);
  closeItemPopup();_sel=-1;
}
function doEquip(){itemPrimaryAction()}
function doSell(){itemSellAction()}

function renderSkills(sk){
  sk=sk||{};
  var a=document.getElementById(&#x27;activeSkills&#x27;);
  var p=document.getElementById(&#x27;passiveSkills&#x27;);
  if(!a||!p)return;

  var active=Array.isArray(sk.active)?sk.active:[];
  var passive=Array.isArray(sk.passive)?sk.passive:[];

  a.innerHTML=&#x27;&#x27;;
  for(var i=0;i&lt;4;i++){
    a.appendChild(active[i]?makeSkillCard(active[i],false):makeSkillPlaceholder(false));
  }

  p.innerHTML=&#x27;&#x27;;
  for(var j=0;j&lt;5;j++){
    p.appendChild(passive[j]?makeSkillCard(passive[j],true):makeSkillPlaceholder(true));
  }
}

function skillRank(id){return Math.max(0,Math.min(3,(INV.skillRanks&&INV.skillRanks[id])||0));}
function skillRule(rank){
  if(rank<=0)return {cost:1,chance:1,next:1};
  if(rank===1)return {cost:2,chance:.45,next:2};
  if(rank===2)return {cost:4,chance:.40,next:3};
  return null;
}
function grimChanceForLevel(lv){
  lv=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,(lv|0)||1));
  if(lv<=5)return .0030;
  if(lv<=10)return .0036;
  if(lv<=15)return .0045;
  return .0060;
}
function pushGrimoireDrop(e){
  if(!ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)return;
  var g=ALL_GRIMOIRES[Math.floor(Math.random()*ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)];
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*40,
    kind:'grimoire',skillId:g.id,name:'Гримуар · '+g.n,skillName:g.n,
    classKey:g.classKey,className:g.className,skillType:g.type,rarity:'rare',icon:'📖',bob:Math.random()*6
  });
}
function tryGrimoireUpgrade(skillId){
  var sk=findGrimoireSkill(skillId);if(!sk)return;
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls);
  if(sk.classKey!==ck){showPickup('Гримуар другого класса: '+sk.className,'#ff8888');return;}
  var rank=skillRank(skillId),rule=skillRule(rank);
  if(!rule){showPickup(sk.n+' уже III ранга','#ffd168');return;}
  var have=(INV.grimoires&&INV.grimoires[skillId])||0;
  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}
  INV.grimoires[skillId]=have-rule.cost;
  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
// Determine which sprite row to use based on facing direction
// 0=back/up, 1=front/down, 2=side
function getDirRow(){
  // During standing attack OR run-and-attack, face the target/shot while
  // movement itself remains controlled by the joystick.
  if((P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0) && P.meleeAng !== undefined){
    const ax = Math.cos(P.meleeAng);
    const ay = Math.sin(P.meleeAng);
    if(Math.abs(ay) > Math.abs(ax) * 0.8){
      return ay > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  // During movement, use velocity with smooth direction switching
  const sp = Math.sqrt(P.vx*P.vx + P.vy*P.vy);
  if(sp > 0.5){
    // Use a threshold that favors vertical for more natural 4-dir movement
    if(Math.abs(P.vy) > Math.abs(P.vx) * 0.8){
      P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if(Math.abs(P.vx) > Math.abs(P.vy) * 0.8) {
      P.lastDir = 2;
    } else {
      // Diagonal: pick based on dominant axis
      if(Math.abs(P.vy) >= Math.abs(P.vx)) {
        P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        P.lastDir = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return P.lastDir;
}

  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}

  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
// Determine which sprite row to use based on facing direction
// 0=back/up, 1=front/down, 2=side
function getDirRow(){
  // During standing attack OR run-and-attack, face the target/shot while
  // movement itself remains controlled by the joystick.
  if((P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0) && P.meleeAng !== undefined){
    const ax = Math.cos(P.meleeAng);
    const ay = Math.sin(P.meleeAng);
    if(Math.abs(ay) > Math.abs(ax) * 0.8){
      return ay > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  // During movement, use velocity with smooth direction switching
  const sp = Math.sqrt(P.vx*P.vx + P.vy*P.vy);
  if(sp > 0.5){
    // Use a threshold that favors vertical for more natural 4-dir movement
    if(Math.abs(P.vy) > Math.abs(P.vx) * 0.8){
      P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if(Math.abs(P.vx) > Math.abs(P.vy) * 0.8) {
      P.lastDir = 2;
    } else {
      // Diagonal: pick based on dominant axis
      if(Math.abs(P.vy) >= Math.abs(P.vx)) {
        P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        P.lastDir = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return P.lastDir;
}

function pushGrimoireDrop(e){
  if(!ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)return;
  var g=ALL_GRIMOIRES[Math.floor(Math.random()*ALL_GRIMOIRES.length)];
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*40,
    kind:'grimoire',skillId:g.id,name:'Гримуар · '+g.n,skillName:g.n,
    classKey:g.classKey,className:g.className,skillType:g.type,rarity:'rare',icon:'📖',bob:Math.random()*6
  });
}
function tryGrimoireUpgrade(skillId){
  var sk=findGrimoireSkill(skillId);if(!sk)return;
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls);
  if(sk.classKey!==ck){showPickup('Гримуар другого класса: '+sk.className,'#ff8888');return;}
  var rank=skillRank(skillId),rule=skillRule(rank);
  if(!rule){showPickup(sk.n+' уже III ранга','#ffd168');return;}
  var have=(INV.grimoires&&INV.grimoires[skillId])||0;
  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}
  INV.grimoires[skillId]=have-rule.cost;
  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}

  return 'misc';
}

  if(!Array.isArray(INV.auctionLots))INV.auctionLots=[];
  var now=Date.now(),keep=[],expired=0,legacyGold=0,repriced=0;
  INV.auctionLots.forEach(function(l){
    if(!l||!l.item)return;
    if(l.currency==='gold'){auctionReturnPayload(l.item,l.qty||1);legacyGold++;return}
    if((l.expiresAt||0)>0&&(l.expiresAt||0)<=now){auctionReturnPayload(l.item,l.qty||1);expired++;return}
    var fp=auctionMinPrices(l.item),want=l.currency==='gram'?fp.gram:fp.ppa;
    if(!Number.isFinite(Number(l.price))||Number(l.price)<want){l.price=want;repriced++}
    keep.push(l)
  });
  if(expired||legacyGold||repriced){INV.auctionLots=keep;saveGame();sendInvState();updateUI();if(legacyGold)showPickup('Аукцион · Gold-лоты сняты и возвращены','#ffd168');else if(expired)showPickup('Аукцион · истёкшие лоты возвращены','#ffd168')}
}

function blackMarketOfferImage(o){
  if(!o)return '';
  if(o.kind==='statRune'){var _rd=runeDefByKey(o.refId);return _rd?_rd.img:''}
  if(o.kind==='material')return ((MATERIAL_DB[o.refId]||{}).src)||'';
  if(o.kind==='stone')return o.refId==='normal'?PPA_V172_ART.normalStone:(o.refId==='premium'?PPA_V172_ART.premiumStone:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune);
  if(o.kind==='feather')return (PHOENIX_FEATHER_IMG&&PHOENIX_FEATHER_IMG.src)||'';
  if(o.kind==='consumable')return o.refId==='portal_scroll'?PPA_TELEPORT_SCROLL_IMG:((SHOP_ICON_ART&&SHOP_ICON_ART[o.refId])||'');
  if(o.kind==='grimoire'){var g=GRIMOIRE_ART[o.refId]||{};return g.card||g.icon||''}
  if(o.kind==='pet'){var ps=PET_DIR_ART[o.petName]||{};return ps.S||ps.E||''}
  if(o.kind==='wings'){var ws=WING_DIR_ART[o.rarity]||{};return ws.S||''}
  if(o.kind==='accessory'){
    if(o.slot==='cloak')return accessoryIconForRarity('cloak',o.rarity)||'';
    if(o.slot==='artifact')return accessoryIconForRarity('artifact',o.rarity)||'';
    if(o.slot==='necklace'){var a=JEWELRY_VARIANTS.necklace||[];return a.length?(a[0].img||''):''}
  }
  return ''
}
function blackMarketOfferIcon(o){
  if(!o)return '◆';
  if(o.kind==='statRune'){var _rd=runeDefByKey(o.refId);return _rd?_rd.icon:'◇'}
  if(o.kind==='stone')return o.refId==='rune'?'ᚱ':'✦';
  if(o.kind==='feather')return '🔥';
  if(o.kind==='pet')return '🐾';
  if(o.kind==='wings')return '🪽';
  if(o.slot==='cloak')return '🧥';
  if(o.slot==='necklace')return '📿';
  if(o.slot==='artifact')return '🔮';
  if(o.kind==='grimoire')return '📘';
  if(o.kind==='consumable')return o.refId==='portal_scroll'?'📜':'✦';
  return '◆'
}

}
function sendBlackMarketState(){

    mysteryBought:!!bm.mysteryBought,mysteryPrice:bm.mysteryPrice||500,
    buyback:(bm.buyback||[]).map(function(x){return blackMarketBuybackUi(x,bm)})
  }},'*')}catch(e){}
}

  qty=Math.max(1,Math.floor(qty||1));
  if(o.kind==='statRune')return addStatRune(o.refId,qty);

  if(o.kind==='stone'){INV.stones[o.refId]=(INV.stones[o.refId]||0)+qty;return true}
  if(o.kind==='feather'){INV.feathers.phoenix=(INV.feathers.phoenix||0)+qty;return true}
  if(o.kind==='consumable'){
    if(o.refId==='xp_scroll')INV.consumables.xpScroll=(INV.consumables.xpScroll||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='magic_small')INV.consumables.magicSmall=(INV.consumables.magicSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='atk_speed_small')INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall=(INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='run_spee

ials[o.refId]||0)+qty;return true}
  if(o.kind==='stone'){INV.stones[o.refId]=(INV.stones[o.refId]||0)+qty;return true}
  if(o.kind==='feather'){INV.feathers.phoenix=(INV.feathers.phoenix||0)+qty;return true}
  if(o.kind==='consumable'){
    if(o.refId==='xp_scroll')INV.consumables.xpScroll=(INV.consumables.xpScroll||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='magic_small')INV.consumables.magicSmall=(INV.consumables.magicSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='atk_speed_small')INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall=(INV.consumables.atkSpeedSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='run_speed_small')INV.consumables.speedSmall=(INV.consumables.speedSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='phys_small')INV.consumables.physSmall=(INV.consumables.physSmall||0)+qty;
    else if(o.refId==='portal_scroll')INV.consumables.portalStone=(INV.consumables.portalStone||0)+qty;
    else return false;
    return true
  }
  if(o.kind==='grimoire'){INV.grimoires[o.refId]=(INV.grimoires[o.refId]||0)+qty;return true}
  if((INV.bag||[]).length>=100)return false;
  var it=null;
  if(o.kind==='pet'){
    var ps=PET_DIR_ART[o.petName]||null;
    it={uid:'bm_pet_'+Date.now(),name:o.petName||'Питомец',petName:o.petName||'Питомец',slot:'pet',rarity:o.rarity||'common',enh:0,classKey:'all',className:'Все классы',icon:'🐾',img:(ps&&ps.S)||'',dirSprites:ps,stats:craftStats('pet','pet',o.petName||'',o.rarity||'common'),bonusText:'Чёрный рынок',sell:0,blackMarket:true}
  }else if(o.kind==='wings'){
    var ws=WING_DIR_ART[o.rarity]||WING_DIR_ART.rare;
    it={uid:'bm_wings_'+Date.now(),name:(RPREF[o.rarity]||'')+'Крылья',slot:'wings',rarity:o.rarity||'rare',enh:0,classKey:'all',className:'Все классы',icon:'🪽',img:(ws&&ws.S)||'',dirSprites:ws||null,stats:accessoryStatValues('wings',o.rarity||'rare'),sell:0,blackMarket:true}
  }else if(o.kind==='accessory'){
    var ak=o.slot||o.accessoryKind||'artifact',ar=o.rarity||'rare',ai='';
    if(ak==='cloak')ai=accessoryIconForRarity('cloak',ar)||'';
    else if(ak==='artifact')ai=accessoryIconForRarity('artifact',ar)||'';
    else if(ak==='necklace'){var nv=JEWELRY_VARIANTS.necklace||[];ai=nv.length?(nv[0].img||''):''}
    it={uid:'bm_'+ak+'_'+Date.now(),name:(RPREF[ar]||'')+(ak==='cloak'?'Плащ':ak==='necklace'?'Ожерелье':'Артефакт'),slot:ak,rarity:ar,enh:0,classKey:'all',className:'Все классы',icon:ak==='cloak'?'🧥':ak==='necklace'?'📿':'🔮',img:ai,stats:ak==='necklace'?Object.assign({},NECKLACE_STAT_VALUES[ar]||{}):accessoryStatValues(ak,ar),sell:0,blackMarket:true}
  }
  if(!it)return false;

  // V70: prepare Black Market physical item exactly like normal inventory gear.
  it.blackMarket=true;
  it.source='blackMarket';
  try{ppaHydrateItemArt(it)}catch(_){}
  try{
    if(['artifact','cloak','wings','necklace'].includes(it.slot))normalizeAccessoryItem(it);
    else syncItemBM(it);
  }catch(_){}
  INV.bag.push(it);

  // Verify the granted object really landed in the bag.
  return INV.bag.indexOf(it)>=0
}

function blackMarketMysteryReward(){
  var mats=blackMarketMaterialPool(),gr=blackMarketCurrentGrimoires(),r=Math.random();
  if(r<0.23)return {kind:'stone',refId:'premium',name:'Премиум камень заточки ×2',qty:2};
  if(r<0.38)return {kind:'stone',refId:'rune',name:'Премиум руна заточки',qty:1};
  if(r<0.52)return {kind:'feather',refId:'phoenix',name:'Перо Феникса',qty:1};
  if(r<0.70)return {kind:'consumable',refId:'xp_scroll',name:'Свиток опыта ×2',qty:2};
  if(r<0.88&&mats[0])return {kind:'material',refId:mats[0],name:mats[0]+' ×4',qty:4};
  if(gr.length){var g=gr[Math.floor(Math.random()*gr.length)];return {kind:'grimoire',refId:g.id,name:g.n||'Гримуар',qty:1}}
  return {kind:'stone',refId:'premium',name:'Премиум камень заточки ×3',qty:3}
}

}

function classKeyFromName(name){
  var n=String(name||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  var aliases={
    'СТРАЖ':'tank','ТАНК':'tank',
    'ВАРВАР':'barbarian','БЕРСЕРК':'barbarian',
    'ПАЛАДИН':'paladin',
    'ГНОМ':'gnome','ГНОМ-КАНОНИР':'gnome',
    'ЛУЧНИК':'archer',
    'МАГ':'mage',
    'УБИЙЦА':'assassin','АССАСИН':'assassin',
    'ЖРЕЦ':'priest'
  };
  if(aliases[n])return aliases[n];
  for(var k in CLASS_SKILLS){
    if(String(CLASS_SKILLS[k].name||'').trim().toUpperCase()===n)return k;
  }
  return null;
}

// === V211 CHARACTER XP CURVE ===============================================
// XP needed to go from the CURRENT level to the next one.
// Early levels are deliberately slower than before; from level 10 onward
// the requirement grows by 20% per level so progression stays meaningful
// without the old runaway x1.4 curve.
const XP_REQ_EARLY={1:200,2:300,3:450,4:650,5:900,6:1200,7:1600,8:2100,9:2700,10:3400};
function xpRequiredForLevel(level){
  const L=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(level)||1));
  if(L<=10)return XP_REQ_EARLY[L];
  return Math.max(3400,Math.round((3400*Math.pow(1.20,L-10))/100)*100);
}
function syncXpRequirement(){P.xn=xpRequiredForLevel(P.lvl);return P.xn;}

function gnomeFireCannonball(){
  // Select ONCE at the moment of the shot. No target search is done in the
  // projectile update loop.
  let target=null;
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e)})||null;
    if(target){
      const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
      if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>playerBasicRange()+edge)target=null;
    }
  }
  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=7;

  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  const muzzleX=P.x+dx/dist*24;
  const muzzleY=P.y-7+dy/dist*10;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.push({
    x:muzzleX,
    y:muzzleY,
    vx:dx/dist*speed,
    vy:dy/dist*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target
  });

  // clearly without adding effects into the sprite sheet.

}
function targetIsValid(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0)return false;
  if(typeof clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget==='function'&&clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(e))return false;
  const maxD=P.scene==='dungeon'?520:(P.scene==='clansiege'?1800:((P.scene==='clanboss1'||P.scene==='worldboss')?1250:900));
  const d=Math.hypot(e.x-P.x,e.y-P.y);
  if(e.isAiFighter&&e.aiClass==='assassin'&&Date.now()<(e.aiHiddenUntil||0))return false;
  if(d>maxD)return false;
  if(!hasTargetLine(e))return false;

  // В подземелье цель существует только пока игрок остаётся
  // в комнате этого моба. Вышел из комнаты — метка сразу сбрасывается.
  if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&e.room!==undefined&&!dgPointInRoom(e.room,P.x,P.y,0)){
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function findNear(){
  // Clan raid has one authoritative target. Prefer it directly so mobile
  // attack/skills never lose the boss because of generic mob selection.
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const cb=EN.find(function(x){return x&&x.isClanBoss&&x.hp>0});
    if(cb&&targetIsValid(cb))return cb;
  }

  const maxD=P.scene==='dungeon'?520:(P.scene==='clansiege'?1800:((P.scene==='clanboss1'||P.scene==='worldboss')?1250:900)),maxD2=maxD*maxD;
  // Cheap first pass: no Math.hypot and no ray-march through the dungeon mask.
  // Keep only a handful of nearest candidates, then LOS-check those.
  let cand=[];
  for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
    const e=EN[i];if(!e||e.hp<=0)continue;
    if(typeof clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget==='function'&&clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(e))continue;
    const dx=e.x-P.x,dy=e.y-P.y,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    if(d2>maxD2)continue;
    if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&e.room!==undefined&&!dgPointInRoom(e.room,P.x,P.y,0))continue;
    if(cand.length<4){
      cand.push({e:e,d2:d2});
      cand.sort(function(a,b){return a.d2-b.d2});
    }else if(d2<cand[3].d2){
      cand[3]={e:e,d2:d2};
      cand.sort(function(a,b){return a.d2-b.d2});
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<cand.length;i++){
    if(targetIsValid(cand[i].e))return cand[i].e;
  }
  return null;
}
function playerIsMoving(){
  return Math.abs(jX)>0.08||Math.abs(jY)>0.08||Math.abs(P.vx)>0.15||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.15;
}

function skillTarget(maxRange){
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    return clanBossSkillTargetDirect(maxRange);
  }

  var e=null;

  // Prefer the current valid target, then fall back to nearest enemy.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    var cur=EN.find(function(x){return x&&x.id==P.tid&&x.hp>0});
    if(cur&&targetIsValid(cur))e=cur;
  }
  if(!e)e=findNear();
  if(!e)return null;

  var dist=Math.hypot(e.x-P.x,e.y-P.y);

  // V85: large clan boss uses an edge-reach bonus.
  // This makes skills react to the visible boss body instead of demanding
  // that the player stand almost inside the boss's center point.
  var edgeBonus=(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&e.isClanBoss)
    ? Math.max(150,(e.sz||176)*0.98)
    : 0;

  if(maxRange&&dist>maxRange+edgeBonus)return null;
  P.tid=e.id;
  return e;
}
function skillCanStart(sk,rank,mp,cd){
  if(typeof clanSiegeCapturing==='function'&&clanSiegeCapturing()){
    showPickup('🏰 Идёт захват замка · навыки недоступны','#ffe39a');return false;

  if(P.dead||transitioning)return false;
  if((P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam')&&!pvpCombatEnabled){
    showPickup('Подготовка к раунду · урон отключён','#d9ba82');
    return false;
  }
  if(P.scene==='safe'){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · только в боевой зоне','#c990ff');
    return false;
  }
  var left=activeSkillCooldownLeft(sk.id);
  if(left>0){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · перезарядка '+Math.ceil(left)+'с','#8f8fa8');
    return false;
  }
  if((P.mp||0)<mp){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · не хватает маны','#5fa0ff');
    return false;
  }
  P.mp=Math.max(0,P.mp-mp);
  setActiveSkillCooldown(sk.id,cd);
  return true;
}

function castAssassinSkill(sk,rank){
  // Test combat values for the first working pass. Learning/rank rules stay unchanged.
  if(sk.id==='assa_shadow_dash'){
    var e=skillTarget(300);
    var mp=4,cd=[0,10,9,8][rank];
    if(!skillCanStart(sk,rank,mp,cd))return true;

    var dx,dy,dist;
    if(e){
      dx=e.x-P.x;dy=e.y-P.y;dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
      var stop=(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&e.isClanBoss)
        ? Math.max(72,(e.sz||176)*0.88)
        : 48;
      var travel=Math.max(0,Math.min(180,dist-stop));
      dx=dx/dist*travel;dy=dy/dist*travel;
    }else{
      var jl=Math.hypot(jX,jY);
      if(jl>.25){dx=jX/jl*145;dy=jY/jl*145}
      else{dx=(P.face||1)*145;dy=0}
    }

    if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
      var mv=dgSlide(P.x,P.y,dx,dy,P.sz*.24);
      P.x=mv.x;P.y=mv.y;
    }else if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
      var dashSteps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx,dy)/10));
      var stepX=dx/dashSteps,stepY=dy/dashSteps;
      for(var dsStep=0;dsStep<dashSteps;dsStep++){
        var mv=clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(P.x,P.y,stepX,stepY,P.sz*.24
---
  var mp=7,cd=[0,24,22,20][rank];
    if(!skillCanStart(sk,rank,mp,cd))return true;

    var hpPart=e.mhp?e.hp/e.mhp:1;
    var threshold=[0,.30,.35,.40][rank];
    var mult=hpPart<=threshold?[0,3.2,3.8,4.5][rank]:[0,1.45,1.65,1.90][rank];
    var dmg=skillEnemyHit(e,mult,'#ff4d9b',.25);

    for(var j=0;j<16;j++){
      var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r=10+Math.random()*65;
      PT.push({x:e.x+Math.cos(a)*r,y:e.y+Math.sin(a)*r,
        vx:-Math.cos(a)*2,vy:-Math.sin(a)*2,
        life:16,ml:16,sz:2+Math.random()*4,col:'#7b174c'});
    }
    showPickup(sk.n+(hpPart<=threshold?' · ПРИГОВОР! ':' · ')+'−'+dmg,'#ff72bb');
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

function useLearnedHudSkill(slotIndex){
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls),c=ck?GRIMOIRE_CATALOG[ck]:null;
  var sk=c&&c.active?c.active[slotIndex]:null;
  if(!sk)return;

  var rank=skillRank(sk.id);

  // HUD never learns or upgrades skills.
  if(rank<=0){
    showPickup('🔒 '+sk.n+' · изучается только во вкладке навыков','#b0a0c0');
    return;
  }

  // First combat pass: all 4 Assassin skills are now functional.
  if(ck==='assassin' && castAssassinSkill(sk,rank)){
    updateSkillButtons();
    return;
  }

  // Other classes keep their learned state, but are not silently mapped to old skills.
  showPickup(sk.n+' · эффект этого класса подключим отдельно','#c990ff');
}

const _combatSkillInputStamp=[0,0,0,0];
function triggerHudSkillInput(slotIndex,ev){
  if(ev){
    try{ev.preventDefault()}catch(_){}
    try{ev.stopPropagation()}catch(_){}
  }

  const now=Date.now();
  if(now-_combatSkillInputStamp[slotIndex]<170)return;
  _combatSkillInputStamp[slotIndex]=now;

  try{
    useLearnedHudSkill(slotIndex);
  }catch(err){
    console.error('HUD skill input failed',slotIndex,err);
    showPickup('НАВЫК · ошибка ввода','#ff9f9f');
  }
}

function v174AiRefreshInfo(){
  const box=document.getElementById('v174AiPanel');if(!box)return;
  const c=V174_AI_CLASS[V174_AI_PREFS.cls],d=V174_AI_DIFF[V174_AI_PREFS.diff];
  const old=(typeof GRIMOIRE_CATALOG!=='undefined'&&GRIMOIRE_CATALOG[V174_AI_PREFS.cls])?GRIMOIRE_CATALOG[V174_AI_PREFS.cls]:null;
  const pass=old&&old.passive?old.passive.map(x=>x.n).join(' · '):'Все классовые пассивы активны';
  box.querySelector('#v174AiInfo').innerHTML=
    '<b style="color:#fff0c5">'+c.role+'</b><br>'+
    'Навыки ранга <b style="color:#d6adff">'+['','I','II','III'][d.rank]+'</b>: '+c.skills.join(' · ')+'<br>'+
    '<span style="color:#83d69b">Пассивы:</span> '+pass;
}

function v174AiSetCast(e,name,ms){
  const now=Date.now(),c=V174_AI_CLASS[e.aiClass];
  e.aiCastName=name;e.aiCastUntil=now+(ms||650);
  e.aiSkillIndex=(c&&Array.isArray(c.skills))?c.skills.indexOf(name):-1;
  e.aiSkillBadgeUntil=now+Math.max(650,Math.min(1050,(ms||650)+180));
  // Short movement hold makes the attack sprite readable instead of looking
  // like the AI is running through / pushing the player while dealing damage.
  e.aiAttackHoldUntil=now+(name==='Обычная атака'?210:Math.max(280,Math.min(460,ms||380)));
  e.aiAnim='attack';e.aiAnimUntil=now+Math.max(330,Math.min(760,ms||450));
}

function v174AiRankMul(e){return 1+(Math.max(1,e.aiRank||1)-1)*.14}
function v174AiPlayerDamage(e,mul,type,pen,forceCrit){
  if(!pvpCombatEnabled||P.dead||P.hp<=0)return 0;
  if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge())return 0;
  let raw=Math.max(1,e.aiAtk*mul*v174AiRankMul(e));
  if(e.aiClass==='barbarian'){
    const missing=1-Math.max(0,e.hp)/Math.max(1,e.mhp);
    raw*=1+Math.min(.30,missing*.30); // Ярость берсерка.
  }
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin'&&P.hp/P.mhp<.40)raw*=1.25; // Смертельная хватка.
  if(e.aiClass==='archer'){
    const dd=Math.hypot(P.x-e.x,P.y-e.y);
    if(dd>260)raw*=1.30; // Снайпер.
  }
  if(e.aiClass==='mage')raw*=1.15;
  if(Date.now()<e.aiAtkBuffUntil)raw*=1.35;
  let crit=!!forceCrit||Math.random()<((e.aiClass==='assassin'?0.20:e.aiClass==='barbarian'?0.14:0.08));
  if(crit)raw*=e.aiCritDmg||1.8;
  pen=Math.max(0,Math.min(60,Number(pen)||Number(e.aiPen)||0));
  let real;
  if(type==='magic'){
    const res=Math.max(0,Math.min(80,(Number(P.magicResist)||0)*(1-pen/100)));
    const dr=Math.max(0,Math.min(75,(Number(P.damageReduction)||0)+(typeof v189TempDR==='function'?v189TempDR():0)));
    real=raw*(1-res/100)*(1-dr/100);
  }else{
    const df=Math.max(0,(Number(P.def)||0)*(1-pen/100));
    const dr=Math.max(0,Math.min(75,(Number(P.damageReduction)||0)+(typeof v189TempDR==='function'?v189TempDR():0)));
    real=raw*(1-df/(df+70))*(1-dr/100);
  }
  real=Math.max(1,Math.round(real));
  P.hp=Math.max(0,P.hp-real);P.lastCombatAt=Date.now();
  e.aiHitFxUntil=Date.now()+170;
  e.aiHitFxType=type||'physical';
  e.aiH
---
til:0,
    aiRebirthReady:false,aiRebirthUsed:false,aiRespawnAt:0,aiLastHp:0,
    aiEveryShot:0,aiCastName:'',aiCastUntil:0,aiDelayed:null
  };
  e.aiLastHp=e.hp;
  // Passive baselines.
  if(e.aiClass==='tank')e.baseDef=Math.round(e.baseDef*1.15);
  if(e.aiClass==='paladin')e.baseDef=Math.round(e.baseDef*1.08);
  if(e.aiClass==='mage')e.aiMagicPower=1.15;
  if(e.aiClass==='archer')e.sp*=1.10;
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin')e.aiCritDmg=2.10;
  if(e.aiClass==='barbarian')e.aiCritDmg=2.05;
  if(e.aiClass==='gnome')e.aiPen=25;
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin')e.aiPen=20;
  e.def=e.baseDef;
  EN.push(e);
  P.tid=null;
  P.hp=P.mhp;P.mp=P.mmp;
  P.aiRootUntil=0;P.aiSlowUntil=0;P.aiDotUntil=0;P.aiDotNext=0;
  return e;
}

function premiumApplyTargetClass(targetKey){
  const c=PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_STATS[targetKey];
  if(!c)return false;

  applyClassBaseProfile(targetKey,P.lvl);

  // Keep level / XP / rebirths. Return all earned stat points for a fresh
  // redistribution on the new class.
  const a=P.statAlloc||{};
  const refunded=(Number(P.statPts)||0)+Object.keys(a).reduce(function(sum,k){
    return sum+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(a[k])||0));
  },0);
  P.statAlloc={hp:0,mp:0,atk:0,def:0,spd:0,atkspd:0,critdmg:0,crit:0,dodge:0};
  P.statPts=refunded;

  // Old class combat state never carries across.
  P.anim='idle';P.animFrame=0;P.animTimer=0;P.attacking=false;
  P.dir8=4;P.tid=null;P.shootT=0;P.recoil=0;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length=0;
  PLAYER_ARROWS.length=0;
  P.skills=[];
  P.skillCd=[0,0,0,0];
  P.dmgMul=1;P.slowMul=1;P.chain=1;

  recomputeStats();
  P.hp=P.mhp;
  P.mp=P.mmp;
  return true;
}

function premiumChangeClass(targetKey){
  targetKey=String(targetKey||'').toLowerCase();
  const cfg=PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_STATS[targetKey];
  if(!cfg){premiumClassChangeResult(false,'Класс не найден',targetKey);return}

  // Paid class change is a town service, not a combat switch.
  if(P.scene!=='safe'){
    premiumClassChangeResult(false,'Сменить класс можно только в Мирном городе',targetKey);return;
  }

  const oldKey=currentGearClassKey();
  if(oldKey===targetKey){
    premiumClassChangeResult(false,'Этот класс уже выбран',targetKey);return;
  }

  const have=Number(INV.gram)||0;
  if(have+1e-9<PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_PRICE){
    premiumClassChangeResult(false,'Не хватает Gram · нужно '+PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_PRICE,targetKey);return;
  }

  const oldName=CLASS_DISPLAY[oldKey]||P.cls||oldKey;
  const converted=premiumConvertOwnedClassGear(oldKey,targetKey);

  // 10 Gram is the service price. This is SPENDING, not a verified real-money
  // top-up, so it must not create auction slots.
  INV.gram=Math.round((have-PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_PRICE)*10)/10;
  if(typeof recordGramSpend==='function')recordGramSpend(PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_PRICE);

  premiumApplyTargetClass(targetKey);

  if(!INV.premiumShop)INV.premiumShop={purchasedBundles:{}};
  INV.premiumShop.lastClassChangeAt=Date.now();
  INV.premiumShop.classChangeCount=Math.max(0,Number(INV.premiumShop.classChangeCount)||0)+1;

  syncAllItemBM();
  saveGame();
  sendInvState();sendPremiumState();sendAuctionState();sendStorageState();sendClanState();
  updateUI();updateConsumableHud(true);

  const msg='Класс изменён: '+oldName+' → '+(CLASS_DISPLAY[targetKey]||cfg.name)+
    ' · экипировки преобразовано: '+converted;
  showPickup('⚔ '+msg+' · −'+PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_PRICE+' Gram','#ffd16b');
  premiumClassChangeResult(true,msg,targetKey);
}

function equipFromBag(idx){
  var it=INV.bag[idx];if(!it)return;
  var ck=currentGearClassKey();
  if(it.classKey&&it.classKey!=='all'&&it.classKey!==ck){
    showPickup('Только для класса: '+(it.className||CLASS_DISPLAY[it.classKey]||it.classKey),'#ff7777');return;
  }
  INV.bag.splice(idx,1);
  var prev=INV.equipped[it.slot];
  INV.equipped[it.slot]=it;
  if(prev)INV.bag.push(prev);

  if(it.slot==='pet'){
    resetPetFollower();showPickup('🐾 Пет надет · автосбор лута включён','#8dff9a');
  }else if(it.slot==='wings'){
    showPickup('🪽 Крылья надеты','#c990ff');
  }else if(it.slot==='cloak'){
    showPickup('🧥 Плащ надет','#d6b176');
  }else if(it.slot==='artifact'){
    showPickup('🔮 Артефакт надет','#c990ff');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}

function ppaCanRebuildItemArt(it){
  if(!it||!it.slot)return false;
  if(it.slot==='pet'){
    var pn=it.petName||it.name;
    return !!(pn&&typeof PET_DIR_ART!=='undefined'&&PET_DIR_ART[pn]);
  }
  if(it.slot==='wings'){
    return !!(typeof WING_DIR_ART!=='undefined'&&(WING_DIR_ART[it.rarity]||WING_DIR_ART.rare));
  }
  if(it.slot==='cloak'||it.slot==='artifact')return true;
  if(it.slot==='necklace')return true;
  return !!(typeof CLASS_ART_SLOTS!=='undefined'&&CLASS_ART_SLOTS[it.slot]&&it.classKey&&it.classKey!=='all');
}
function ppaCompactItemForSave(it){
  if(!it||typeof it!=='object')return it;
  var o=Object.assign({},it);
  if(ppaCanRebuildItemArt(o)){
    delete o.img;
    delete o.dirSprites;
    delete o.cardArt;
    delete o.iconArt;
  }
  return o;
}

function healPotion(key,amount,label){

  if(P.hp>=P.mhp){showPickup('HP уже полное','#ffd16b');return false}
  if(potionCooldownBlocked('hp'))return false;
  INV.potions[key]--;
  startPotionCooldown('hp');
  P.hp=Math.min(P.mhp,P.hp+amount);
  for(let j=0;j<10;j++)PT.push({x:P.x,y:P.y-15,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:-Math.random()*4-2,life:15,ml:15,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:'#33ff33'});
  showPickup(label+' · +'+amount+' HP','#8dff9a');
  saveGame();sendInvState();sendMerchantState();updateUI();updateConsumableHud(true);
  return true;
}

function renderSkills(sk){
  sk=sk||{};
  var a=document.getElementById(&#x27;activeSkills&#x27;);
  var p=document.getElementById(&#x27;passiveSkills&#x27;);
  if(!a||!p)return;

  var active=Array.isArray(sk.active)?sk.active:[];
  var passive=Array.isArray(sk.passive)?sk.passive:[];

  a.innerHTML=&#x27;&#x27;;
  for(var i=0;i&lt;4;i++){
    a.appendChild(active[i]?makeSkillCard(active[i],false):makeSkillPlaceholder(false));
  }

  p.innerHTML=&#x27;&#x27;;
  for(var j=0;j&lt;5;j++){
    p.appendChild(passive[j]?makeSkillCard(passive[j],true):makeSkillPlaceholder(true));
  }
}

  function pushGear(e,rar){
    var it=genItem(20,false,rar);
    LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*40,kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }
  function pushConsumable(e,key,name,img,icon,color,amount){
    LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,kind:'consumable',consumable:key,name:name,img:img||'',icon:icon||'◆',color:color||'#d69cff',rarity:'epic',amount:amount||1,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }
  function baseCurrency(e,anti,bossPpa){
    var base=e.gold||5;
    var gold=Math.max(0,Math.round(base*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4)*clanGoldMul()*premiumGoldMul()*anti));
    if(gold>0)LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*20,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*20,kind:'gold',amount:gold,bob:Math.random()*6});
    if(bossPpa){LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,kind:'ppa',amount:bossPpa,bob:Math.random()*6});}
    else if(Math.random()<PPA_DROP_CHANCE*premiumDropMul()*anti)LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,kind:'ppa',amount:PPA_DROP_AMOUNT,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }
  function maybeFeatherMob(e,anti){
    if(Math.random()<PHOENIX_FEATHER_MOB_CHANCE*rewardDropMul()*anti)LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,kind:'phoenixFeather',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }

  function drop2130(e){
    var anti=antiFarmRewardMul(e),lv=Math.max(21,Math.min(30,Number(e.lvl)||21)),mul=rewardDropMul()*anti;

    if(roll(.008,mul))pushGrimoireDrop(e);
  }

function imgBox(src,rarity){
  rarity=rarity||&#x27;common&#x27;;
  return &#x27;&lt;span class=&quot;bundleThumb &#x27;+rarity+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+(src?&#x27;&lt;img src=&quot;&#x27;+src+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;◆&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&#x27;;
}
function rarityRu(r){
  return ({common:&#x27;СЕРЫЙ&#x27;,uncommon:&#x27;ЗЕЛЁНЫЙ&#x27;,rare:&#x27;СИНИЙ&#x27;,epic:&#x27;ЭПИК&#x27;,legendary:&#x27;ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫЙ&#x27;})[r]||String(r||&#x27;&#x27;);
}
function rarityTag(r){
  return &#x27;&lt;span class=&quot;rarityTag &#x27;+r+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+rarityRu(r)+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&#x27;;
}
function currentGear(){
  return PREMIUM_ASSETS.gear[GAME_STATE.classKey]||PREMIUM_ASSETS.gear.assassin||{};
}
function gearForBundle(rarity){
  if(rarity===&#x27;epic&#x27;){
    const src=GAME_STATE.epicGear||{},out={};
    GEAR_ORDER.forEach(slot=&gt;{
      const b=src[slot]||{},fallback=(currentGear()[slot]||{});
      let pic=b.img||&#x27;&#x27;;
      if(!pic){try{if(parent&amp;&amp;typeof parent.PPA_UI_EPIC_GEAR_IMG===&#x27;function&#x27;)pic=parent.PPA_UI_EPIC_GEAR_IMG(GAME_STATE.classKey,slot)||&#x27;&#x27;}catch(_){}}
      out[slot]={name:b.name||fallback.name||SLOT_LABEL[slot]||slot,img:pic||fallback.img||&#x27;&#x27;};
    });
    return out;
  }
  return currentGear();
}

function craftAccessory(){
  let it=ACC[accKind],img=accessoryImg(accKind,accRarity);
  let recipe=[],price=it.prices[accRarity];

  if(accRarity===&#x27;legendary&#x27;){
    recipe=[{name:&#x27;Кристалл Бездны&#x27;,count:1000}];
    price=12000;
  }else{
    let q=qtyForRarity(accRarity);
    recipe=[
      {name:it.mats[0],count:q[0]},
      {name:it.mats[1],count:q[1]},
      {name:it.mats[2],count:q[2]}
    ];
    if(accRarity===&#x27;epic&#x27;)recipe.push({name:&#x27;Перо Феникса&#x27;,count:1});
  }

  if(accKind===&#x27;ring&#x27;){
    sendRealCraft({
      kind:&#x27;gear&#x27;,slot:&#x27;ring&#x27;,name:&#x27;Легендарное кольцо&#x27;,icon:it.icon,img:img,
      rarity:&#x27;legendary&#x27;,bonusText:(it.stats.legendary||[]).join(&#x27; · &#x27;),
      recipe:[{name:&#x27;Кристалл Бездны&#x27;,count:1000}],ppa:12000
    });
    return;
  }
  sendRealCraft({
    kind:accKind===&#x27;wings&#x27;?&#x27;wings&#x27;:&#x27;accessory&#x27;,
    accessoryKind:accKind,name:it.name,icon:it.icon,img:img,
    rarity:accRarity,bonusText:(it.stats[accRarity]||[]).join(&#x27; · &#x27;),
    recipe:recipe,ppa:price
  });
}

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardSpriteIndex(){
  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

---
nction fartPushUniversalRune(e,rarity){
  const types=Object.keys(RUNE_TYPES||{});
  if(!types.length)return false;
  const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0];
  const d=runeDefByKey(runeKey(type,rarity));
  if(!d)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'statRune',
    runeKey:d.key,name:d.name,icon:d.icon,img:d.img,
    rarity:rarity,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,name){
  const def=MATERIAL_DB[name];
  if(!def)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    kind:'material',
    name:name,
    rarity:'legendary',
    src:def.src,
    amount:1,
    bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');
    if(it){
      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Epic universal stat rune — 0.00012%.
  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'stone',stone:'rune',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6,
      rarity:'rare',
      name:'Премиум руна заточки',
      img:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
    });
  }

  // Legendary crafting materials — independent ultra-rare rolls.
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Изумруд Вечности');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Адская руда');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Кристалл Бездны');
}

function fartRandomMaterialFrom(rarity){
  const pool=(typeof MATERIAL_BY_RARITY!=='undefined'&&MATERIAL_BY_RARITY[rarity])||[];
  if(!pool.length)return null;
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

// Возрождение моба ровно на его собственной точке спавна
function spawnMobAtPoint(si,fx){
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si];if(!p)return;
  let px=p[0]*DG_SCALE,py=p[1]*DG_SCALE;
  if(!dgCircleWalk(px,py,18)){const q=dgNearestWalk(px,py);px=q.x;py=q.y}
  const t=mobByLvl(DG_SPAWN_LVL[si]);
  let e=mkMob(t,px,py);
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')e=applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si);
  else if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')e=applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si);
  e.si=si;               // точка спавна (дом моба)
  e.room=p[2];           // номер комнаты
  e.roomLevel=DG_ROOM_LVL[p[2]]||e.lvl;
  e.hx=px;e.hy=py;       // возврат на место после потери агро
  EN.push(e);
  if(fx)for(let j=0;j<7;j++)PT.push({x:px,y:py,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*5,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*5,life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*3,col:'#8866ff'});
  return e;
}

// Возрождение моба ровно на его собственной точке спавна
function spawnMobAtPoint(si,fx){
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si];if(!p)return;
  let px=p[0]*DG_SCALE,py=p[1]*DG_SCALE;
  if(!dgCircleWalk(px,py,18)){const q=dgNearestWalk(px,py);px=q.x;py=q.y}
  const t=mobByLvl(DG_SPAWN_LVL[si]);
  let e=mkMob(t,px,py);
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')e=applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si);
  else if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')e=applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si);
  e.si=si;               // точка спавна (дом моба)
  e.room=p[2];           // номер комнаты
  e.roomLevel=DG_ROOM_LVL[p[2]]||e.lvl;
  e.hx=px;e.hy=py;       // возврат на место после потери агро
  EN.push(e);
  if(fx)for(let j=0;j<7;j++)PT.push({x:px,y:py,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*5,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*5,life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*3,col:'#8866ff'});
  return e;
}

function stableItemArtIndex(it,len){
  if(!len)return 0;var uid=String((it&&(it.uid||it.name))||'');var seed=0;
  for(var i=0;i<uid.length;i++)seed=(seed+uid.charCodeAt(i)*(i+1))>>>0;
  return seed%len;
}

function classGearArt(rarity,ck,slot){
  // V266: Legendary class sets use the newly approved transparent sheet.
  // Legendary ring visuals follow the crafted class theme, but the ring item
  // itself remains universal/equippable by every class.
  if(rarity==='legendary'){
    if(slot==='ring'&&LEGENDARY_RING_ART&&LEGENDARY_RING_ART.length)return LEGENDARY_RING_ART[0];
    var ls=LEGENDARY_CLASS_GEAR_ART&&LEGENDARY_CLASS_GEAR_ART[ck];
    if(ls&&ls[slot])return ls[slot];
  }
  if(rarity==='epic'){
    if(slot==='ring'&&EPIC_RING_ART&&EPIC_RING_ART.length)return EPIC_RING_ART[0];
    var es=EPIC_CLASS_GEAR_ART&&EPIC_CLASS_GEAR_ART[ck];
    if(es&&es[slot])return es[slot];
  }
  var set=CLASS_GEAR_ART[ck];
  return set&&set[slot]?set[slot]:'';
}
function refreshGearArt(it){
  if(!it)return it;
  if(it.slot==='necklace'){
    it.classKey='all';it.className='Все классы';

  toast.classList.add(&#x27;show&#x27;);

function imgBox(src,rarity){
  rarity=rarity||&#x27;common&#x27;;
  return &#x27;&lt;span class=&quot;bundleThumb &#x27;+rarity+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+(src?&#x27;&lt;img src=&quot;&#x27;+src+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;◆&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&#x27;;
}
function rarityRu(r){
  return ({common:&#x27;СЕРЫЙ&#x27;,uncommon:&#x27;ЗЕЛЁНЫЙ&#x27;,rare:&#x27;СИНИЙ&#x27;,epic:&#x27;ЭПИК&#x27;,legendary:&#x27;ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫЙ&#x27;})[r]||String(r||&#x27;&#x27;);
}
function rarityTag(r){
  return &#x27;&lt;span class=&quot;rarityTag &#x27;+r+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+rarityRu(r)+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&#x27;;

  if(id===&#x27;growth&#x27;)return &#x27;100 малых HP + 100 малых MP · полный зелёный комплект текущего класса +4 · 5 премиум HP + 5 премиум MP.&#x27;;
  if(id===&#x27;adventurer&#x27;)return &#x27;Полный зелёный комплект текущего класса: 7 предметов +5 · зелёный питомец на выбор +5.&#x27;;
  if(id===&#x27;unique&#x27;)return &#x27;Полный синий комплект текущего класса: 7 предметов +5 · синий питомец на выбор +5.&#x27;;
  return &#x27;Полный эпический комплект текущего класса: 7 предметов +5 · уникальный эпик-пет «Звёздный Хранитель» +5 · статы автоматически под класс.&#x27;;
}
function choiceGearHtml(id,need){
  const rarity=id===&#x27;epic&#x27;?&#x27;epic&#x27;:&#x27;rare&#x27;;
  const g=gearForBundle(rarity);
  return &#x27;&lt;div class=&quot;choiceTitle&quot;&gt;Выбери снаряжение · &#x27;+need+&#x27; шт. · &#x27;+rarityTag(rarity)+&#x27;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;choiceGrid&quot;&gt;&#x27;+GEAR_ORDER.map(slot=&gt;{
    const x=g[slot]||{};
    return &#x27;&lt;button class=&quot;choice gearChoice &#x27;+rarity+&#x27;&quot; data-slot=&quot;&#x27;+slot+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+
      (x.img?&#x27;&lt;img src=&quot;&#x27;+x.img+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;span&gt;&#x27;+(x.name||SLOT_LABEL[slot])+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/button&gt;&#x27;;
  }).join(&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;/div&gt;&#x27;;
}
function choicePetHtml(label,rarity){
  const pets=PREMIUM_ASSETS.pets||{};
  rarity=rarity||&#x27;common&#x27;;
  return &#x27;&lt;div class=&quot;choiceTitle&quot;&gt;Выбери питомца · &#x27;+label+&#x27; · &#x27;+rarityTag(rarity)+&#x27;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;choiceGrid&quot;&gt;&#x27;+Object.keys(pets).map(name=&gt;
    &#x27;&lt;button class=&quot;choice petChoice &#x27;+rarity+&#x27;&quot; data-pet=&quot;&#x27;+name+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&#x27;+
      &#x27;&lt;img src=&quot;&#x27;+pets[name]+&#x27;&quot;&gt;&lt;span&gt;&#x27;+name+&#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;small style=&quot;display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#9e917d;font-size:7px;line-height:1.15&quot;&gt;&#x27;+(((PET_PLUS5_DESC[name]||{})[rarity])||&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/button&gt;&#x27;
  ).join(&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27;&lt;/div&gt;&#x27;;
}
